title: Accenture is excluded as an enterprise anti-persona: the brief carries no procurement-track motion
content:
Accenture is present in the Flowable Partner Finder and marked do-not-pitch, labelled as enterprise anti-persona AP-2 at 513,000 staff. The wording of the flag is precise and worth preserving: there is "no procurement-track motion in this brief".

That locates the missing piece in Powerhouse's own approach rather than in Accenture. The exclusion is not a claim that a firm of this size could never adopt the stack; it is a claim that the brief has no play for a buyer who can only be reached through enterprise procurement. Read that way, the exclusion is a scoping decision with an expiry condition — it would need revisiting if a procurement-led motion were ever built.

The same exclusion catches the other largest names in the sweep: Tata Consultancy Services at 600,000+ staff and EPAM on non-EU enterprise scale. Since those are also the firms carrying the highest partner tiers, the practical lesson is that presence in a vendor's partner directory is not a qualification signal at the top end of the market.
